text:
linda (PeopleOps): quick help please — drafting a 1-page preboard + week1 + 30/60/90 template for the PM joining Mon. want copy that hiring managers can paste into offer acceptance emails.
cecil (Hiring Manager): yes. we need something concise: day1 agenda, who-to-cc for access, and a tiny first-week deliverable.
samir (Eng Lead): add eng ramp items: repo access, onboarding issue, pairing schedule. also suggest weekly 1:1s and a 30/60/90 review cadence.
emma (IT): managers should send: full legal name, preferred name, shipping address, laptop preference. IT lead time ~48h for imaging. add `/device-request` command snippet for managers.
linda (PeopleOps): plan: Pre-boarding checklist, Day1 sample agenda, Week1 rituals (small win), editable 30/60/90. keeping it minimal so managers actually use it.
---
Pre-boarding (before Day 1):
- Manager: confirm shipping + laptop request to IT (`/device-request @it device:macbook-pro`)
- Manager: invite to team Slack channels (#product, pm-team)
- PeopleOps: send welcome email + calendar stub for weekly 1:1s
- IT: provision account, add to SSO groups

Sample Day 1 (flexible):
- 9:30am manager intro (expectations, scope) — 30m
- 10:15am team round-robin (who we are) — 30m
- 11:15am IT/account check — 15m
- 1:00pm product context & roadmap — 45m
- 3:00pm buddy pairing — 60m

Week1 focus (goal: context + a small win):
- daily 30m check-in with manager first 3 days
- 3x week buddy pairing (first 2 weeks recommended)
- shadow key cross-functional meetings
- small onboarding project (first PR or customer issue doc)

Manager checklist (quick):
- confirm device & shipping by EOD Fri
- add to key Slack channels & calendar invites
- nominate buddy/mentor and seed first tasks
- set Top 3 onboarding goals and share in 1st 1:1

30 / 60 / 90 (editable bullets):
"30 days: learn & connect — complete access, meet stakeholders, finish onboarding task",
"60 days: contribute — own a small area, ship an enhancement",
"90 days: deliver & scale — lead cross-team work, propose process improvements"
---
cecil (Hiring Manager): very usable. can you add a short place for feedback cadence and a place to record "Top 3 goals"?
linda (PeopleOps): added. also will attach calendar bundle for weekly 1:1s + 30/60/90 review slots.
samir (Eng Lead): eng note: repo `redwood/core`, onboarding seed issue + first PR target two weeks; internal dev setup guide: https://redwood.internal/dev-setup
emma (IT): device staging requested. if manager doesn't confirm model by EOD Fri, standard MacBook Pro shipped. tag `#it-requests` for expedited handling.
people-ops-bot: task created — "Onboard: PM (Mon)" assigned to linda, emma. due in 2 days.
linda (PeopleOps): cecil — paste shipping address here when confirmed and i'll trigger rest. thanks all, keeping it short should help reduce the last-minute scramble. :tada:
